The candidate instead scans the whole grid and uses vacuous/contradictory subexpressions (`... and False`). Necessary fix: locate the door cell `(dx, dy)` by a guarded grid scan of `type == 'door'`, then return `not (env.grid.get(dx - 1, dy) is not None and env.grid.get(dx - 1, dy).type == 'ball')`, as a single guarded expression. The remaining predicates (`door_open`, `has_door_key`, `target_picked_up`, and the event predicate `key_lost`, which correctly compares the previous valuation against the current observation and stays false on the first step) are consistent with the grounding.
